title: Abstand
content: {"id":"2954102e-d15d-49d7-b25c-5e54d3d5c5d0","type":"https://serlo.org/editor","variant":"serlo-org","domainOrigin":"serlo.org","version":2,"editorVersion":"0.22.0","dateModified":"2025-02-26T18:27:19.528Z","document":{"plugin":"rows","state":[{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Am Ende dieser Lerneinheit kannst du …"}]},{"type":"unordered-list","children":[{"type":"list-item","children":[{"type":"list-item-child","children":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"den Abstand eines Punktes zu einer Gerade als kürzesten Verbindung zu ihr erkennen."}]}]}]},{"type":"list-item","children":[{"type":"list-item-child","children":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"darstellen, dass die kürzeste Verbindung stets senkrecht auf der Geraden steht."}]}]}]},{"type":"list-item","children":[{"type":"list-item-child","children":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"den Abstand aus einer Zeichnung abmessen."}]}]}]},{"type":"list-item","children":[{"type":"list-item-child","children":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"den Abstand zweier Geraden bestimmen."}]}]}]},{"type":"list-item","children":[{"type":"list-item-child","children":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"erklären, dass parallele Geraden immer den gleichen Abstand zueinander haben."}]}]}]}]}],"id":"3b996571-744d-4b05-b0a4-851c3fee4429"}],"id":"1dd73a28-edf9-4c4e-a057-fd3f01686453"}}
